newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel to close bottling facility.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel to close bottling facility.

text.p: Beer and food conglomerate San Miguel Corp said on Monday it will be closing one of its bottling facilities in the Philippines.

"This is a strategic move that will optimize our existing modernized breweries and maximize efficiencies. It will help ensure our long term profitability and competitiveness," Faustino Galang, San Miguel Brewing Group (SMBG) president said in a statement. SMBG is the division that manages the firm's beer business.
SMBG said that the Philippine beer market has contracted by 15 percent since 1990 when higher ad valorem tax was imposed.
SMBG said its five domestic breweries are capable of meeting the projected demand in the next few years.
The bottling facility in Laguna in southern Manila will be closed down on January 1, 1997.
Sales operations in Luzon will not be affected by the closure and employees will either be redeployed or be covered by a special separation programme, San Miguel said.
